title: Benchmark large tier complete — 85,599x token efficiency, PASS on critical test
description: benchmark-system-v1 is now complete across all 3 tiers. Large tier: 63 source files + 8 services, 400MB runtime-generated reference files (never committed), WAI selective load of 5 files vs baseline 75. Results: small=73.8 WEI (3,902x), medium=74.4 WEI (7,844x), large=85,599x token efficiency. All tiers PASS reference-file-avoidance critical test. benchmark-results.jsonl now tracks longitudinal WEI scores. Shipit runs small+medium with --persist automatically.
rationale: The large tier (85,599x) is the headline proof-of-value number for Wheelwright's selective loading claim. This is the publishable benchmark result.
